body.backend_role: Static file server only - no video processing

common_issues.api_errors: Check Network tab for failed requests to ai.google.dev
common_issues.no_polling_logs: Video generation may not have started or completed already
common_issues.timeout: Extended to 10 minutes but complex videos may take longer

frontend_architecture.storage: Browser IndexedDB with 4 stores: characters, scenes, videoClips, objects

troubleshooting_steps: 1. Check browser console for video polling messages
2. Verify API key is present: window.API_KEY in browser console
3. Check IndexedDB: DevTools -> Application -> Storage -> IndexedDB
